title: Cancel a launch
text: Cancel ends a launch and, when its session has registered but not yet received its instructions, ends that session in the same transaction: terminated, claims released and one native-process reap queued. A launch whose instructions were delivered is refused as launch_session_working, naming `yoke sessions terminate SESSION-ID --reason` for a deliberate kill. A native process that never registered moves the launch to outcome_unknown for reconciliation. A cancelled launch is final; reconcile refuses it. Observed in source and tests; deployed proof is pending.
